obligations.expected_behavior: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages must not share mutable state with one another.
forbidden_result: Mutable state is shared across any of the listed subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, or rollback stages.
obligations.observable_result: Mutable-state boundaries remain isolated for all listed categories during execution and rollback.
obligations.state_after: Each listed category operates with independently isolated mutable state.
obligations.state_before: Execution or rollback may involve multiple listed categories whose mutable state could otherwise be shared.
obligations.subject: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages
obligations.trigger: Whenever any of the listed categories execute, consume, or perform rollback stages.

obligations.expected_behavior: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages must not share evidence in a way that can create false success.
forbidden_result: Evidence is reused or shared across the listed categories such that it produces a false success result.
A success outcome is accepted because of cross-category evidence contamination.
obligations.observable_result: Evidence for each listed category is isolated, and success determinations cannot arise from shared or contaminated evidence.
obligations.state_after: Evidence remains isolated across all listed categories without enabling false success.
obligations.state_before: Evidence from multiple listed categories may otherwise be shared or reused during evaluation or rollback.
obligations.subject: Subjects, Probes, Matrix Cases, Consumers, and rollback stages
obligations.trigger: Whenever evidence is produced, consumed, evaluated, or used during rollback.
